Hefei, Anhui, China, 14th – 18th October, 2024 Agenda Item: 6.2.1 Document for: Approval Introduction In this contribution, we provide TP to TR 38.922 on scope clarifications. Discussion During review of the TR 38.922 v0.2.0, it was observed that consideration of SBFD statements mentioning Rel-19 work does introduce ambiguity of the reuse RF requirements. Therefore, it is proposed to add a clarification note to the scope, explaining timeline of the reused RF requirements. The following wording is proposed: NOTE 1: Findings captured in this technical report represent status of Rel-18 NR specifications at the time of writing, unless otherwise stated. It was also observed, that LS from ITU-R WP 5D asks for UE and BS parameters, the same way as is was done multiple times in the past already. W

[CR CR0054 for 37.941] Reason for change: During the evaluation of potential simplifications of BS TRP test methods applicability, it was identified that description of applicability of TRP measurement methods in TR 37.941 clause 6.3.2.1 is unclear. In this CR, we provide clarification to multiple notes in Table 6.3.2.1-1 on applicability of TRP measurement methods and chambers to the type of emissions to be measured. Summary of change: Clarification of the note on two TRP measurements for ACLR. Removal of redundant information from the pre-scan note. Clarification of the conditions applicable for the Pattern multiplication note. Other editorial corrections. Consequences if not approved: Wording ambiguities would remain in notes to table 6.3.2.1-1.
